parameters.name: FLT_TYPE
parameters.help: Whitening parameters can be constant or vary as a function of time.

choices.label: Time-Invariant Parameters
choices.help: Whitening parameters do not vary as a function of time

choices.label: Time-Variant Parameters
choices.help: Whitening parameters vary as a function of time.

parameters.name: AGC_OPER
parameters.help: The length in millisecs. of the AGC-like scalar used to perform time-variant scaling of frequency-sliced traces.

parameters.name: FILT_PAD
parameters.help: The percentage of the input trace length to pad with zeroes (to avoid 'wrap-around' effects of circular FFT's).

parameters.name: AUTOMODE
parameters.help: With this option, only 4 corner frequencies are supplied and the panels are automatically designed.

parameters.name: NUM_PANL
parameters.help: The number of equal size filter panels to automatically calculate over the supplied spectrum

parameters.name: F_SLICE1
parameters.help: These four frequencies define the beginning and ending slopes for the automated filter design.

parameters.name: F_SLICE2
parameters.help: These frequencies define overlapping filter panels (high end slope of one panel defines low end slope of next panel).

parameters.name: F_SLICE3
parameters.help: These four frequencies define the beginning and ending slopes for the automated filter design.

parameters.name: F_SLICE4
parameters.help: These frequencies define overlapping filter panels (high end slope of one panel defines low end slope of next panel).

parameters.name: SCALMODE
parameters.help: Choose method of averaging agc scalars to back out of balanced trace.

parameters.name: remute_option
parameters.prompt: Re-apply trace mute after spectral whitening?
parameters.help: Trace mutes (such as first break suppression mutes) may be re-applied after whitening.
